dataStudio.name: Monstera Cloud
dataStudio.description:
Monstera Cloud ingests advertising performance from Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok for Business into your workspace. This Looker Studio community connector charts that data after you authorize with your Google account (no API key required).

1) Create a Monstera account: https://monsteracloud.com/register
2) Connect ad platforms under Data Sources and ensure metrics have synced.
3) In Looker Studio, add this connector and authorize when prompted.
4) Optional filters: Platform and specific Accounts.
5) Pick a report date range (required). Choose dimensions (e.g. date, campaign) and metrics (spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, revenue).

Derived ratios (CPC, CTR, CPM, ROAS) are not included as connector fields because pre-computed per-row ratios produce incorrect totals when Looker Studio re-aggregates them. Instead, add these as Calculated Fields in your report:
  CPC = Spend / Clicks
  CTR = Clicks / Impressions
  CPM = (Spend / Impressions) * 1000
  ROAS = Revenue / Spend

Help: https://monsteracloud.com/support — Connector overview: https://monsteracloud.com/looker-studio
dataStudio.shortDescription: Workspace ad metrics from Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok in Looker Studio (authorize with Google).
